name: Virginia Environmental Endowment: Virginia Program
summary: Twice-yearly grants for projects in Virginia that improve local rivers and water quality, restore the Chesapeake Bay, and conserve large landscapes, riparian buffers and headwater streams. Land purchases are not funded.
reporting: Grantees report on progress quarterly, with a final report including financials at the end of the project.

steps: Letter of Intent, for applied research only
Full application as a Word document

eligibility.rule: Apply no more than once a year unless VEE approves otherwise
Do not resubmit a previously denied application unless VEE approves
Proposal is not an unsolicited pure research proposal
If applied research, has a direct policy tie and a Letter of Intent 4 weeks before the deadline
Proposal excludes general support, overhead, indirect, capital, land, building, renovation, endowment and lawsuit costs

documents: List of the Board of Directors
IRS tax-exempt determination letter, if applicable

calls.label: June 15 and December 1 rounds

status.quote: Applications are accepted biannually for Virginia Program grants, with deadlines of June 15th and December 1st.

recurring.quote: Proposals must be received by VEE at info@vee.org by 5 p.m. (ET) on June 15 for the June round and December 1 for the December round.

calls.recurring: Proposals are due by 5 p.m. ET on June 15 and December 1 each year; a weekend or holiday moves it to the next business day.

geography.quote: Improve local rivers and protect water quality throughout Virginia

access.quote: Does VEE accept unsolicited proposals? Yes, but all prospective grantees are encouraged to submit applications that are consistent with VEE's priorities

window.quote: Applications are accepted biannually for Virginia Program grants, with deadlines of June 15th and December 1st.

co_finance_required.quote: A minimum 1:1 match is required for all VA Program proposals.

reporting.quote: In general, grantees report on progress quarterly. Grant funds are released after reports are submitted and reviewed. A final report is due at the end of the project with greater detail and financial reports.

effort.quote: only upon receipt and review of a one-page Letter of Intent received at least four weeks prior to the application deadline.
PLEASE SUBMIT COMPLETED APPLICATION AS A WORD DOCUMENT
The Board normally makes its decisions on proposals in April (for the December round) and October (for the June round).

eligibility.quote: VEE does not accept applications from individuals.
applicants may not apply to the Virginia Program more than once a year, absent prior approval from VEE.
VEE does not accept resubmission of applications previously denied, absent prior approval from VEE.
VEE does not accept unsolicited pure research proposals.

VEE will consider proposals for applied research that have a direct tie to policy outcomes consistent with the Virginia Program priorities but only upon receipt and review of a one-page Letter of Intent received at least four weeks prior to the application deadline.
VEE does not provide funding for general support, overhead, indirect costs, capital projects, land purchases, building construction or renovation, endowments, or lawsuits.

after_award.quote: In general, grantees report on progress quarterly. Grant funds are released after reports are submitted and reviewed. A final report is due at the end of the project with greater detail and financial reports.

documents.quote: a copy of the applicant's annual operations budget, a list of the Board of Directors, and a copy of an IRS tax-exempt determination letter (if applicable)
